planningAssumptions.profile: Indian family moving from Bengaluru in March 2027; parents late 30s, children 6 and 10, Dubai Internet City workplace.
planningAssumptions.bedrooms: Two, conditional on children sharing; restart genuine three-bedroom search otherwise.
planningAssumptions.recommendation: Al Barsha 1 first; Discovery Gardens value/Jebel Ali school branch; The Greens short-work-commute branch. School feasibility before long lease.
planningAssumptions.exclusions: School tuition/bus/admission/books/uniform, temporary accommodation, visa/attestation, flights, international shipping beyond local move reserve, vehicles/fuel/tolls, groceries, healthcare and other living costs; actual parking/gas deposits and management/renewal fees unknown. Signing reserve also excludes 11500 moving/furniture and later bills.
planningAssumptions.assumptionStatus: Common tax-inclusive usage reserves, equal instalments and unchanged rent/tariffs isolate rent/payment effects. They are not quotes or proof of identical building efficiency/provider. Refundable deposits are tied-up cash, not spending.

uncertainties: No March 2027 quote, availability, inspected property, measured commute, official unit index result, executed lease or actual all-in bill; no guaranteed 30-minute route.
No suitable genuine three-bedroom near DIC at AED 120000 established. Palmera headline three beds conflicts with two plus study; Mirdif does not solve commute.

L2 cheque field two versus headline twelve; L4 Cactus versus Contemporary cluster and unverified Metro walk; L5 October field versus end-August year-unknown prose; L6 area approximations; L7 area basis, shared pool and flight-path claim unverified.

KHDA establishes Indian curriculum and primary-grade span/location only, not verified CBSE affiliation, seats, individual grade placement, bus, March/April transfer, 2027 grades or fees. No rankings adopted.
Allowance salary inclusion, payout timing, permitted use and bank/cheque-book readiness unresolved. Extra-cheque prices are hypothetical, not a verified market premium.

Landlord deposit/broker percentages unconfirmed for selected three homes; cooling provider/capacity/tariff/allocated components, parking/gas/building deposits and admin/renewal charges unknown. No universal deposit or minor-repair threshold.

Ejari trustee published 220 versus components 219.75; DEWA charges need move-date confirmation. Empower consumption units ambiguous and unused worked example inconsistent; RSB caps not actual approved building charges. No double-counted fuel, VAT, deposits or cooling.

Amendment notice ninety days unless otherwise agreed is distinct from qualifying twelve-month eviction; breach/nonpayment has separate process. Old two-year freeze superseded; Arabic prevails. Future law/fees/index require recheck.
Historic clean-session-only exception remains unresolved; no source refresh, contacts, forms, payments or publication during this authoring pass.
